summary: Back-of-house apron at Riverstage venue; work area, gated, no place to stay.
reasons: Crew trucks and equipment fill the yard

drivers.seclusion: Screened by trees and mangroves, but it is an active venue yard with crew nearby.
drivers.access_and_room: Paved venue service road with gates 63 m away; the apron is full of equipment and work vehicles, leaving no clear room.
drivers.traffic: Event, delivery and crew traffic, plus concert noise.
drivers.convention: Venue work vehicles only; no campervans or tents seen.

flags: Mapped gates 63-66 m away, bollards 123 m
Low-lying: about 5-7 m, river 200 m away
sun_shade: Palms and trees shade the south and west; stage building to the east; open to the north.
